     `evidence/unwrap-red-green.md`:
     - a new `#[rstest]` function `prompt_text_drops_the_cli_framing_around_a_pair`, beside
       `prompt_text_unwraps_the_cli_pair_then_unescapes` (`hook.rs:489-526`) and asserting the same two things, with
       eight labelled cases:
       - `measured_long`: two newlines, a `7ccf` pair around a one-line text, one newline → the text;
       - `measured_tag`: step 0's tag prompt, verbatim → step 0's tag text, verbatim (both from
         `evidence/step0-prompts.json`, `tag`);
       - `third_newline_before_stays`: three newlines, the pair, one newline → one newline, then the text;
       - `second_newline_after_stays`: two newlines, the pair, two newlines → the text, then one newline;
       - `one_newline_before_stays`: one newline, the pair, one newline → one newline, then the text;
       - `text_then_framed_pair`: `note:`, two newlines, the pair, one newline → `note:` joined to the text;
       - `two_framed_pairs`: two newlines, pair one, three newlines, pair two, one newline → the two texts joined;
       - `unmatched_open_keeps_its_newlines`: two newlines, an open tag with no close, one newline → unchanged;
     - the `cli_pair` case (`hook.rs:490-493`) expects `"A paste"`;
     - the property `prompt_text_prop_round_trips_a_wrapped_paste` (`hook.rs:649-662`) draws `lead` from `""`,
       `"\n\n"`, `"note: "` and `"\n"`, and expects the lead without a final two-newline run, then the typed text,
       with the one newline after the close gone.
   - Then change `unwrap_pastes` (`hook.rs:195-214`). When it replaces a matched same-id pair with its inner text, it
     also removes, from the prompt as the CLI sent it:
     - the two newlines directly before the open tag, when two are there (a third stays; a lone one stays);
     - the one newline directly after the close tag, when it is there (a second stays).
     Each newline is taken at most once, left to right: a pair takes the newline after its close before the next
     pair's lead is read. An open tag with no matching close removes nothing. `paste_pair`, `PASTE_OPEN`,
     `unescape_tags`, `prompt_origin` and `prompt_text`'s order do not change, and nothing is trimmed.
   - Its doc comment (`hook.rs:193-194`) says what is removed and cites architecture [CLI Version Compatibility].
   - The doc comment on `prompt_origin` (`hook.rs:171-175`) is corrected to the measured reading: on 2.1.287 the
     CLI escapes a typed `pasted_content` tag, and a typed `<task-notification>` in the middle of a prompt arrives as
     typed; the start-of-prompt position is not measured. Its sentence on the cross-session tag stays. The function's
     body does not change.
   - `prompt_text` (`hook.rs:187`) becomes visible inside the crate, so the ledger's two paste arms call it.
   - `tests/hook_events.rs`, the `paste` case of `hook_prompts_arrive_normalised_with_their_origin` (`:276-282`):
     the expected text is `"A paste {CANARY}"`.
   - If the reworked property records a failing seed, commit it in
     `crates/viola-agent-claude/proptest-regressions/hook.txt`.

2. **The rows and their compiled data** (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`).
   - Add three variants to `LedgerRow`, appended after `DialogConcurrency` in `ALL` (17 members), with ids
     `long-paste-wrapper`, `tag-escaping`, `local-command-clear` and the fixed ASCII words:
     - `a long paste unwraps to the text as pasted`;
     - `tag-like text un-escapes to the text as pasted`;
     - `/clear starts a new session and submits no prompt`.
   - Add two compiled probe texts beside `PROBE_PROMPT`, byte for byte the texts step 0 pasted
     (`evidence/step0-prompts.json`, `long.pasted` and `tag.pasted`): the 1 500-byte one-line long text, and the
     200-byte tag-like text, which holds a typed `<pasted_content id="1">` open, its same-id close and
     `<task-notification>`, none at its start. Both are synthetic ASCII with no path, no user name and no
     email-shaped token, and both ask for a one-word reply.
   - Add the local-command list: `/clear` with the post-condition "a new session", `/remote-control` with none. The
     probed command is the list's entry that has a post-condition. Nothing outside this crate names either command.
   - Add a stem lookup beside `dialog_stem` (`ledger.rs:150`): the long text → `paste-1`, the tag-like text →
     `paste-2`, the probed local command → `clear-1`.
   - `Probes` gains Run B's captures in claim order.
   - Add the selection of the hooks a `/clear` fired, over those captures: the `clear` SessionStart, and the
     SessionEnd captured directly before it. The exit's SessionEnd, captured after it, is not one of them.
   - `check` gains three arms over those captures:
     - `long-paste-wrapper`: a UserPromptSubmit capture whose `prompt`, after `prompt_text`, equals the long text;
     - `tag-escaping`: the same equality for the tag-like text;
     - `local-command-clear`: a SessionStart capture after the tag-like turn with `source` `clear` and a non-empty
       `session_id` different from the run's first SessionStart, and no UserPromptSubmit capture carrying the command.
   - Three plain `#[test]` cases in the module's own tests, in the form of
     `check_dialog_rows_fail_when_no_dialog_was_raised` (`ledger.rs:2174`: a loop inside one test, no `#[case]`), so
     each arm is shown to read its capture (the operator's P5 review, inputs#I3):
     - `check_framing_rows_pass_on_the_recorded_shape`: all three rows pass over a clean Run B capture set whose long
       prompt has step 0's wrapped shape;
     - `check_paste_rows_fail_without_a_matching_capture`: for each paste row, a run with no UserPromptSubmit capture
       reads fail, and a run whose capture's `prompt` does not normalise to the compiled text reads fail;
     - `check_local_command_clear_fails_on_each_broken_post_condition`: no `clear` SessionStart reads fail; a `clear`
       SessionStart with the first one's `session_id` reads fail; a UserPromptSubmit capture carrying the command
       reads fail.

3. **Run B's three added pastes** (`src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`, `trusted_run` at `:85-117`).
   - After the existing turn and its `turn` screen, and only while each previous wait succeeded: paste the long text
     and wait for one more UserPromptSubmit capture and one more Stop capture; the same for the tag-like text; then
     paste the probed local command and wait until the first of a new SessionStart capture, a new UserPromptSubmit
     capture, or the deadline. Then let the screen settle, and end the run by Ctrl-C as today.
   - Reuse `wait_for` and `count_of` (`typed.rs:192-219`), the pattern Run C uses (`:135-154`); every wait is bounded
     by `PROBE_DEADLINE`. The timing rows keep reading the first turn only.
   - The run still pastes only into a settled input box with no modal, and a modal start is still killed with no key.
   - As built: after each added turn the screen is settled and the next text is pasted only when the settled rows
     hold the input-box literal and no modal literal (`framing_turns @ typed.rs:257`, the guards at `:261` and
     `:278`). The guard before the paste turns has its test and its remove-the-guard control
     (`verify_pastes_nothing_more_once_the_turn_screen_shows_a_modal`, `evidence/paste-guard-control.md`). Step 12
     changes what that settle waits for; the guard stays.

4. **Verify reads and records Run B** (`src/cmd/verify.rs`).
   - Read Run B's captures into `Probes` beside the dialog runs' (`:199-208`).
   - `record` (`:386-433`) also writes, through the same scrub and the same whole-recording refusal:
     `UserPromptSubmit.paste-1.json`, `UserPromptSubmit.paste-2.json`, `SessionEnd.clear-1.json` and
     `SessionStart.clear-1.json`, the last two being step 2's selection.
   - The step loop and the summary need no edit: both derive the count from `LedgerRow::ALL` (`:353-360`).

5. **The fake agent replays the recorded shapes** (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs`, `submit` at `:425-445`).
   - A new argv option, `--framing`, in the form of `--dialogs` (`:90-91`): with it, a submitted text whose stem
     lookup answers `paste-1` or `paste-2` fires UserPromptSubmit from that recorded variant with its bytes unchanged
     (the recorded `prompt`, not the typed text), then Stop as `--turn-stop` does; a submitted text whose stem is
     `clear-1` fires the recorded `clear-1` SessionEnd and then the recorded `clear-1` SessionStart, and no
     UserPromptSubmit.
   - Without the option the agent behaves as at HEAD: it echoes the typed text, so the two paste rows pass on the
     echo and `local-command-clear` fails. A set that lacks a variant fires nothing for it.
   - No environment variable is read for this. `--local-command-mode` keeps its meaning.

6. **The wrapped send, through the fake agent** (`tests/cli_send.rs`; one added case, no existing line changes).
   - `send_long_text_wrapped_by_the_cli_is_confirmed`: boot through the file's `boot` helper (`:28-42`) with
     `--framing`. The sent text is the text inside the pair of the committed
     `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/UserPromptSubmit.paste-1.json`, taken out by the test's own literal framing. Send it
     with `--json`.
   - It asserts: exit 0; the `ok` document with the cursor; the records after the cursor are `send-issued`,
     `prompt-submitted` with `{text: <the sent text>, origin: "driver"}`, `send-confirmed`; and the receipt's
     UserPromptSubmit hook entry offered the recorded variant's bytes (`stdin_hex`), so the wrapper met the wrapped
     shape and not an echo.
   - It waits on the records it asserts, in the form of `path2_send_confirms_with_cl1_events` (`:170-197`). No sleep.
   - Its fixture exists only after step 10, so it is green from the record round on.
   - **The one-shot control**, after step 10: put `unwrap_pastes` back to its HEAD body in the working tree, run this
     case alone and read it red (the send is not claimed: exit 13, `not-delivered` / `no-prompt-submitted`); restore
     the change, run it again and read it green. Both readings go to `evidence/send-wrapped-control.md`. Re-read the
     site before the neutralising edit and confirm the edit landed and was restored (`.claude/rules/testing.md`,
     2026-09-25).

7. **The row count at every literal site** (research M8: `/14]`, `14 pass` and `; 14]` counted per file).
   - `tests/cli_verify.rs` (31 sites): `[NN/17]`, the three new step lines, `17 pass  0 fail`, the dialog-less case's
     failing set, and one new case, `verify_without_framing_fails_only_the_clear_row` (`16 pass  1 fail`, exit 1, only
     `local-command-clear` failing).
   - `tests/contract_ledger_probes.rs`: `ROW_IDS` at 17, `STAMPED = ["2.1.287"]`,
     `DRIFT_ONLY = ["2.1.283", "2.1.288"]`, the summary `17 pass  0 fail`.
   - `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/run.rs` (18 sites): `LEDGER_ROWS` at 17 and its case table.
   - `tests/support/verify.rs`, `tests/support/home.rs` (`stamped_home`, `:265`) and
     `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/boot.rs` (boot step 4): pass `--framing` wherever `--dialogs` is passed.
   - `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` and `src/cmd/verify.rs`: their own unit literals, and one unit case
     that a stamp holding exactly the fourteen old ids, all `pass`, reads unverified.
   - As built: `src/run/version_gate.rs` holds one more pin, the unit test `stamps_verdict_needs_the_dialog_rows`,
     which expected a fourteen-row stamp to read verified. It was moved to seventeen rows and recorded as a
     companion (`scope-record.md`). In `src/cmd/verify.rs` the seventeenth step line is asserted by its counter, id
     and verdict, not its words, because the local-command guard entry greps that file.

8. **The contract and hygiene walks** (`tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs`, `tests/contract_fixture_hygiene.rs`,
   `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs`).
   - The drift contract replays `paste-1`, `paste-2` and both `clear-1` variants byte for byte for every set that
     holds them, as it does the dialog variants (`contract_fake_agent_drift.rs:159-213`); a set without them is not
     compared.
   - The hygiene walk reaches the new names; `schemas/claude-fixture.v1.json` moves only if a recorded `clear` shape
     carries a field it refuses.
   - `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs` gains `fake_agent_framing_replays_the_recorded_shapes`.
   - As built: the dialog-replay contract (`fake_agent_dialog_replay_matches_every_recorded_dialog_set`) runs a set
     that holds no framing variant without `--framing` and expects exit 1 for it (2.1.288: its local-command row
     fails on the echo); the dialog tier is still compared byte for byte.

9. **Timing (owed; read at step 15).** Read the verify-driven tests' durations from the first full local `run`
   after the second record round. Move a bound in `.config/nextest.toml` only under `.claude/rules/testing.md`'s
   2026-09-28 / 2026-10-05 rule: a measured designed floor, with a planted-hang control recorded in `evidence/`.
   Otherwise the file is untouched. The partial read so far is in `evidence/paste-guard-control.md`.

10. **The first record round on 2.1.287: done, red, not re-run (rows 2-6 of the session ledger; inputs#I6).**
    - It read `stamped 2.1.287  15 pass  2 fail`, exit 1, on 2026-10-06T20:34:44Z. Nothing was recorded or copied
      (`evidence/record-round-red.md`, `evidence/round-203444Z.txt`).
    - What the later steps take from it: the wrapped long prompt normalises to the pasted text live, at an id other
      than step 0's; and Run B stopped after the long-paste turn because its settled rows held no input-box literal.

11. **The rehearsal (1 session; row 7 of the session ledger), before any change to the wait.**
    - Write row 7 first, with the UTC time read from the clock. Then one scratch probe outside the repository, in
      step 0's form (`evidence/step0-shapes.md`, "How it ran"): the 2.1.287 binary by path, `--model haiku`, a
      scratch plugin capturing the four spine events, 80×24, the inherited `CLAUDE*` names removed, cwd
      `<repo root>/.viola-verify-<pid>/` (0700, removed by the driver).
    - It pastes Run B's exact sequence, each as one bracketed paste and Enter in one write: the probe prompt, the
      long text, the tag-like text, the probed local command (the four compiled texts, byte for byte).
    - Each text after the first is pasted only once the previous turn's Stop is captured and the screen, read
      through the tree's own `Screen`, has been quiet for 300 ms with the input-box literal on it and no modal
      literal. That is the rule step 12 gives Run B.
    - It records, for the long turn and the tag-like turn: the paste, the UserPromptSubmit capture, the Stop capture,
      and the first instant the literal is back on a quiet screen; and for the local command, its two hooks and the
      instant the input box is back. It keeps the raw PTY bytes in the scratch dir for the footer read.
    - It ends as Run B does: Ctrl-C, again after 500 ms. No key is typed into any dialog.
    - **STOP and report, before step 12, with nothing more spent,** when any of these reads:
      1. a modal or a picker on any settled screen;
      2. after an added turn the literal is not back on a quiet screen within 60 s of that turn's Stop;
      3. a captured `prompt` does not normalise to its pasted text under the tree's `prompt_text`;
      4. the local command fires a UserPromptSubmit, or no SessionStart `clear`, or keeps the `session_id`;
      5. a pasted text gets no capture within 30 s of its paste.
    - Not a STOP: the hint standing shorter or longer than at step 0, or another paste id. They are recorded.
    - The record is `evidence/rehearsal-shapes.md`: the timings above, the footer row over the raw bytes, the five
      conditions each with its reading, and what was left behind. The rehearsal is not re-run: the cap holds no
      spare (inputs#I6).

12. **The wait after an added turn, red before green** (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs`, `tests/cli_verify.rs`,
    `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`).
    - **The fake agent's hold.** A new argv option, `--paste-hint-ms <ms>`, in the form of `--stop-receipt-hold-ms`
      (`viola-fake-agent.rs:94-97`), capped by a constant at 8 000 ms. With `--framing` and this option, after the
      long text's replay (the `paste-1` variant) and its Stop, the agent clears the screen instead of drawing the
      `turn` screen, and draws `turn` `<ms>` later. No other turn changes, and without the option the agent behaves
      as before. No environment variable is read. Its parse and its cap are asserted in the file's own
      unit tests of `Opts::parse`, as the existing hold's are (`:783`, `:843`).
    - **The case first.** `verify_window_paste_hint_past_the_gate_maximum_still_stamps` in `tests/cli_verify.rs`:
      the synthetic set, `--paste-hint-ms 6000`, a receipt. It asserts exit 0, the seventeen `pass` lines and
      `stamped 2.1.0  17 pass  0 fail`, and that the trusted run typed the four texts in order (the form of
      `verify_without_framing_fails_only_the_clear_row`, `tests/cli_verify.rs:917`).
    - Run it on the tree as it stands and record the red in `evidence/run-b-wait-red-green.md`. The expected red
      is the live round's own: exit 1, `stamped 2.1.0  15 pass  2 fail`, `tag-escaping` and `local-command-clear`
      failing, two prompts typed by the trusted run. A red of any other shape is a finding: stop and report it.
    - **Then the change**, in `framing_turns` (`typed.rs:257`). After the long turn and after the tag-like turn,
      the rows the paste guard reads come from a wait that ends only when one of these holds, counted from that
      turn's Stop capture:
      - the screen has been quiet for `QUIET_PERIOD` with the input-box literal or a modal literal on a row: its
        rows are returned;
      - the screen is poisoned: no rows;
      - `PROBE_DEADLINE` has passed: no rows.
      A quiet screen with no compiled literal keeps waiting past `GATE_MAX_WAIT`. The guard is unchanged: the next
      text is pasted only when the rows hold the input-box literal and no modal literal, so a modal, a poisoned
      screen and the deadline each end the added pastes with no key.
    - Three plain `#[test]` cases in `typed.rs`'s own tests, over the pure reading the wait polls (the form of
      `settled_without_a_literal_waits_out_the_maximum`, `typed.rs:706`), named so the filter `box_wait_` selects
      exactly them:
      - `box_wait_keeps_waiting_past_the_gate_maximum_without_a_literal`;
      - `box_wait_ends_on_a_quiet_literal_with_its_rows` (the input-box literal, and a modal literal);
      - `box_wait_ends_at_once_on_a_poisoned_screen`.
    - No new test's name holds `settled_`: the named entry over that filter counts the three existing cases.
    - Nothing else moves: `settled` (`typed.rs:478`) and its tests, `Run::settle`'s other call sites (Run A's modal,
      Run B's ready and first turn, Run C, Run D, `input_box_settles`), the first turn's `turn_settle_ms` and `turn`
      screen, the settle after the local command (`:291`), `GATE_MAX_WAIT`, and all of
      `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`.
    - Run the case again and record the green beside the red.
    - If the guard's lines move, re-run the remove-the-guard control of
      `verify_pastes_nothing_more_once_the_turn_screen_shows_a_modal` and add both readings to
      `evidence/paste-guard-control.md` (`.claude/rules/testing.md`, 2026-09-25).

13. **The gates that need no recorded fixture**, before the round: the two lint entries, the unit entry, the three
    named unit entries, the named entry of step 12's case, and the four guard probes. All green, or the round is
    not fired.

14. **The second record round on 2.1.287 (5 sessions; rows 8-12 of the session ledger).**
    - Write the five ledger rows first, with the UTC time read from the clock. Fire the round once with
      `gate.py run --live-legs`: the version probe, then the record entry. It passes on
      `stamped 2.1.287  17 pass  0 fail`; it copies only the new files into `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/`.
    - **A second red round is not retried: STOP and report, and it returns to the founder (inputs#I6).**
    - After the round, record in `evidence/`: the round's lines, that no probe dir of this chunk is left at the
      repository root, and that no `claude` process has a probe-dir cwd.
15. **After a green round:** step 6's one-shot control, step 9's timing read, then the rest of the block.
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/UserPromptSubmit.paste-1.json`, `UserPromptSubmit.paste-2.json` — recorded by step 14
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/SessionEnd.clear-1.json`, `SessionStart.clear-1.json` — recorded by step 14

- `viola-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-local-command-and-paste-framing-rows/evidence/` — `live-sessions.md`,
  `step0-shapes.md`, `step0-prompts.json`, `unwrap-red-green.md`, `paste-guard-control.md`, `record-round-red.md`
  and `round-203444Z.txt` (written); `rehearsal-shapes.md`, `run-b-wait-red-green.md`, `send-wrapped-control.md`,
  the second round's lines

- `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/hook.rs` — `unwrap_pastes` and its cases, the property, the two doc comments,
  `prompt_text` made visible inside the crate (`unwrap_pastes` is called by `prompt_text @ hook.rs:188` alone;
  `prompt_text` by `data_of @ hook.rs:158`; the one reader of the result outside the crate is `claim`, called by
  `append_hook_event @ src/run/send.rs:149`)
- `crates/viola-agent-claude/proptest-regressions/hook.txt` — only if the reworked property records a failing seed
- `src/cmd/verify.rs` — Run B's captures, the recording

- `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` — Run B's pastes (written); the wait after an added turn, step 12 (`framing_turns @
  typed.rs:257`, called by `trusted_run @ typed.rs:87` alone)
- `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs` — `--framing` (written); `--paste-hint-ms`, step 12

- `src/run/version_gate.rs` — one unit test's pinned row set (written; outside research's lists, recorded in
  `scope-record.md`)
- `tests/hook_events.rs` — the `paste` case's expected text
- `tests/cli_send.rs` — one added case

- `tests/cli_verify.rs`, `tests/contract_ledger_probes.rs`, `tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs`,
  `tests/contract_fixture_hygiene.rs`, `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs`, `tests/support/verify.rs`, `tests/support/home.rs`
  (written); `tests/cli_verify.rs` gains step 12's case
- `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/run.rs`, `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/boot.rs`
- `schemas/claude-fixture.v1.json`, `.config/nextest.toml` — each only under its stated condition

One live round is left, on the dev host only: the version probe and the record entry, fired once by
`gate.py run --live-legs` and never re-run by the wrap. The same two entries were fired once already (step 10: the
first round, red; `evidence/round-203444Z.txt`). Step 0 and step 11's rehearsal are scratch sessions outside the gate
block; their records are `evidence/step0-shapes.md` and `evidence/rehearsal-shapes.md`. The record entry regenerates
committed fixtures, so it precedes every entry that reads them. The harness smoke boots the fake agent on a 17-row
stamp.

Four controls mutate source and revert, or read a tree state that exists once, so they are one-shot runs at
implement and not entries: step 1's red before the unwrap change (`evidence/unwrap-red-green.md`, done); the paste
guard's remove-the-guard run (`evidence/paste-guard-control.md`, done); step 12's red before the wait change
(`evidence/run-b-wait-red-green.md`); and step 6's control with the unwrap put back
(`evidence/send-wrapped-control.md`). On every re-run the named entries below guard the same properties.

body:
- (arch) A long paste as the CLI sends it normalises to the pasted text. The named-unit entry over
  `prompt_text_drops_the_cli_framing_around_a_pair` reads `"passed":8,"failed":0`, and
  `evidence/unwrap-red-green.md` holds the same cases red on the untouched `unwrap_pastes` (per architecture
  §Established Decisions [Delivery Confirmation]; §Standard Contracts, `prompt-submitted`).

- (arch, security) The unwrap removes only the measured framing: a third newline before the pair, a second after it
  and a lone one before it all stay; an unmatched open tag removes nothing; a typed pair, which arrives escaped, is

title: M1 — the version the typed probes hit

data.head: ### M1 — the version the typed probes hit

body:
- `viola verify` runs the program named after `--`, and `claude` from PATH when none is named
  (`src/cmd/verify.rs:103-106`). It stamps the version that binary's own `--version` answers
  (`src/cmd/verify.rs:147-163`, `parse_version`), so the stamp always names the binary that was probed.

- Measured on this host, 2026-10-06 ~19:20Z: `claude` on PATH is `~/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/latest/claude`,
  a link to `…/2.1.289/claude`; `claude --version` prints `2.1.289 (Claude Code)`; `mise ls` lists 2.1.287, 2.1.288
  and 2.1.289.

- So a bare `viola verify`, and `agent-run.sh run --local-live` (which uses the program default,
  `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/run.rs:350-351`), hit **2.1.289**. The two earlier chunks reached 2.1.288 and 2.1.287
  only by naming each binary after `--` (`2026-10-05-dialog-rows-and-re-probe/plan.md:277`, `:288`).

title: M2 — what the stamped rows read once the row count grows

data.head: ### M2 — what the stamped rows read once the row count grows

body:
- `ledger::verified` is true only when every row of `LedgerRow::ALL` reads `"pass"` under the version
  (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs:799`). A stamp written at 14 rows lacks any new row, so it reads
  **unverified** from the first build that carries a 15th row. No code path keeps a short stamp verified, so the
  retired R2 gap does not reopen.

- `stamps_verdict` reports a short stamp as plain `(false, None)`: no `parse-rejected` line, no new detail
  (`src/run/version_gate.rs:162-175`). The obs schema does not move for this.

- What goes unverified with it: the full readiness gate (signatures are passed only when `cli_verified`), every
  non-`null` dialog decision (`src/run/dialog.rs:192`, `:339`), and local-command confirmation once it lands.

- **2.1.288 and 2.1.287**: their committed sets (`fixtures/claude/2.1.288/`, `2.1.287/`; 19 files in 2.1.288) hold the
  spine, three screens and twelve dialog variants. They hold no long-paste, tag-escaped or `clear` shape, so the fake
  agent cannot replay a new row from them. `tests/contract_ledger_probes.rs:33` lists both as `STAMPED` and asserts
  `14 pass  0 fail` (`:98`). After the growth each one either gets its new shapes recorded live (5 sessions each,
  M4) or moves to the `DRIFT_ONLY` list beside 2.1.283.

- **2.1.289**: no committed set, no stamp anywhere. The dev host has no `~/.viola/ledger/` at all (the earlier live
  stamps went into per-run record homes under `target/e2e-home/`). A `viola run` on PATH `claude` reads
  `cli_verified:false` today and stays so until one full verify of 2.1.289.

- The default version of the test fleet is 2.1.287 at four literal sites: `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs:19`,
  `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/boot.rs:22`, `tests/support/fake.rs:16`, and `stamped_home` through it. Every root
  test that boots through `stamped_home` fails at the fixture unless that default set replays every row.

title: M3 — the new rows ride Run B; no row needs a session of its own

data.head: ### M3 — the new rows ride Run B; no row needs a session of its own

body:
- Run B (`src/cmd/verify/typed.rs:85-117`) pastes one compiled `PROBE_PROMPT` and waits for its UserPromptSubmit and
  Stop captures. Run C already pastes three prompts in one session, each after the previous Stop (`:122-160`), so
  several pastes in one run is a built pattern.

- Run B's plugin captures the four spine events (`CAPTURE_EVENTS`, `ledger.rs:292`): SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit,
  Stop, SessionEnd. Those are exactly what the three probe-able rows read:
  - **long-paste wrapper** — paste a compiled text past the wrap threshold; post-condition: the captured `prompt`,
    after the compiled unwrap, equals the pasted text;
  - **tag escaping** — paste a compiled text holding tag-like literals; post-condition: the captured `prompt`, after
    the compiled un-escape, equals the pasted text;
  - **local command `/clear`** — paste `/clear`; post-condition: a SessionStart capture with `source` `clear` and a
    `session_id` different from the run's first one, and no UserPromptSubmit capture for it.

- At HEAD `Probes` holds Run B's timings and screens only (`TypedRun`, `ledger.rs:451-459`); its captures are read for
  timing and dropped. The rows need Run B's captures carried in `Probes`.

- The normalisation the two paste rows check is already compiled: harness prefix on the raw start, then
  `unwrap_pastes`, then `unescape_tags` (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/hook.rs:176-189`, `:195-235`). The rows add
  probes and checks, not normalisation code. [premise-corrected: step 0 measured the wrapped prompt with two
  newlines before the pair and one after, which `unwrap_pastes` keeps, so the long-paste check cannot pass on the
  compiled normalisation as it stands — M10; the fix is folded here by inputs#I4]

- `--record` writes the print probe's spine as `<Event>.default.json`, the dialog variants and the three screens
  (`src/cmd/verify.rs:386-433`). The new shapes are three more recorded payloads through the same scrub.

- The fake agent fires `UserPromptSubmit` from `UserPromptSubmit.default.json` with only `prompt` replaced by the
  typed text (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs:425-445`), and fires SessionStart once at launch (`:737`). It emits no
  paste wrapper and no second SessionStart (grep `pasted_content` over the file: 0 hits). The tests extract's
  "paste-wrap form past the fixture's threshold" is test-plan target text, not built.

- One `viola verify` is five `claude` starts: the print probe (`verify.rs:171`), then Runs A, B, C, D
  (`typed.rs:61-82`). `VerifyArgs` has two fields, `record` and `program` (`verify.rs:40-47`): there is no way to run a
  subset, and a subset that stamped would be the R2 gap again.

- Measured twice on 2026-10-05: 5 sessions per version, 10 for two (`2026-10-05-dialog-rows-and-re-probe/evidence/
  live-sessions.md`, rows 4-13).

- Rows riding Run B add pastes to an existing session, so the per-version price stays 5. `/clear` opens a second CLI
  session inside Run B's one process: one more transcript under `~/.claude/projects/`, the accepted residual class.

- A scratch shape probe before any code ("step 0") cost 1 session per shape in both earlier chunks, and each needed a
  re-run after a STOP (4 and 3 spent on step 0).

- Price per row, as the directive asks:

  | row | own sessions | rides |
  |---|---|---|
  | local command `/clear` | 0 | Run B, one more paste |
  | long-paste wrapper | 0 | Run B, one more paste |
  | tag escaping | 0 | Run B, one more paste |
  | harness prefix, cross-session half | no probe path (M6) | needs a second live session sending in, plus the messaging names let through R8 |
  | R8 identity floor | 0 | no probe path inside the capture arm's ruled shape (M7) |
  | shared: step 0 shape probe on 2.1.289 | 1 | one Run-B-shaped scratch session, all three pastes |
  | shared: one full verify per stamped version | 5 | any row count ≥ 1 costs the same |

- Totals: 2.1.289 alone = 1 + 5 = **6**; 2.1.289 and 2.1.288 = **11**; all three = **16**. Each STOP re-run adds 1
  (step 0) or 5 (a record round). The cap has 3 left, so the smallest honest total is 3 over it before any spare.
- What the 3 left can buy alone: step 0 and two spares. No stamp, so no recorded shape, so no green CI for a new row.

- The wrapper's `send` settles on exactly two things: the in-flight text matching a `prompt-submitted` line, or the
  window expiring (`src/run/send.rs:108-131`, `:272-275`). A local command ends `not-delivered` /
  `no-prompt-submitted` after the full 10 s window.

- `append_hook_event` already sees every hook line, `session-start` included, and already ends the running turn on it
  (`send.rs:140-173`). The `/clear` post-condition has its hook point there; the line's `data` carries `cause` and
  `agent_session_id` (`hook.rs:148-155`).

- `SendSlot` holds no `cli_verified` (`send.rs:49-55`); `run` has it at `src/cmd/run.rs:209`. "Not measured on this
  CLI version" needs that bit threaded in.

- The outcome writers: `confirm` records `send-confirmed {cursor}` and logs `send-confirmed{confirmed:true}`
  (`send.rs:325-347`). `schemas/diag-line.v1.json:59-61` already admits `confirmed` as a boolean on the three
  `send-*` events, so `send-confirmed{confirmed:false}` passes G4 with no schema change.

- The human mirror: `MIRROR_WORD = 13` is already sized by `unconfirmable` (`src/human.rs:40-41`), with
  `write_send_open`, `write_read_back`, `write_send_unable`. No `unconfirmable` writer exists, and the client
  (`src/cmd/send.rs:113-127`) renders only `read_back` and `unable`.
- The pinned interim case is `tests/cli_send.rs:373-386`: `/clear` under `--local-command-mode` exits 13.

- The only product mention of the word at HEAD is the comment at `src/human.rs:40` (grep `unconfirmable` over `src`,
  `crates`, `tests`: 1 hit).

- The local-command list per architecture [Delivery Confirmation] is two commands: `/clear` (post-condition measured
  by the probe) and `/remote-control` (no post-condition, so `unconfirmable`). `/remote-control` is never typed by a
  probe: it would open a remote-control link on the founder's account.

title: M6 — the harness-prefix row has no probe path here

data.head: ### M6 — the harness-prefix row has no probe path here

body: - The four prefixes are compiled at `hook.rs:105-110` and matched on the raw start at `:176-182`.

- The literal `cross-session-message` lives in `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/hook.rs` alone among `.rs` files under
  `src`, `crates` and `tests` (`grep -rn cross-session-message --include=*.rs src crates tests`: 11 lines, one file). No standing script or test gates that census (grep over
  `scripts`, `tests`, `.github`: 0 hits); the security history's "census gate" was a one-off chunk gate.

- Both messaging names are on the identity floor (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/lib.rs:19-20`), and a 2.1.289
  session exports both (M7). A `verify` child is spawned under that strip, so it cannot be addressed by another
  session. CARRY 4's claim holds at HEAD, read from the code rather than from the cited research M10, whose text is
  not at that coordinate.

- Model-layer observation on 2.1.289, this phase's own P2: all 14 subagent hand-backs reached the orchestrator framed
  `Another Claude session sent a message:` ahead of `<agent-message from="…">`, and every background-task
  notification arrived inside a `<system-reminder>` block opening `[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT]`, ahead of
  `<task-notification>`. The risk that raised: if the UserPromptSubmit `prompt` carried either preface, `starts_with`
  would miss both prefixes, the turn would be filed `human`, and the next driver `send` would be refused
  `human-typing`.

- Hook-layer measurement on 2.1.289, relayed with the P4 answers (inputs#I2) and re-derived here by counts only, no
  content read out (a scratchpad script over the driver's own log of this session, outside this repository): 16
  UserPromptSubmit records; 14 hold a prompt that STARTS with `<agent-message from=`; 0 start with the
  `Another Claude session sent a message` preface; 0 start with `<task-notification>`. So the preface is a
  model-layer frame only: on 2.1.289 a hand-back reaches the hook starting at the tag, and the compiled prefix
  matches it. CARRY 4's hypothesis is falsified for the `agent-message` form at 2.1.289. The `<task-notification>`
  form stays unmeasured at the hook layer: the 14 task notifications of this phase fired no UserPromptSubmit of their
  own.

title: M10 — step 0's measurement, and what the folded fix touches (the revision, inputs#I4)

data.head: ### M10 — step 0's measurement, and what the folded fix touches (the revision, inputs#I4)

body:
- Step 0 ran once on 2.1.287 (2026-10-06T19:59:04Z, `evidence/step0-shapes.md`; the raw prompts whole in
  `evidence/step0-prompts.json`). STOP 3 fired; the other four conditions read clear.

- **The wrapped shape.** The 1 500-byte paste's `prompt` is `"

<pasted_content id="7ccf">
"` + the text +
  `"
</pasted_content id="7ccf">
"` (1 558 chars, asserted byte for byte by the recording script). The id is 4
  lowercase hex characters. The 200-byte paste was not wrapped.

- **What HEAD does with it.** `unwrap_pastes` replaces only the pair with its inner text
  (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/hook.rs:195-214`, `paste_pair` at `:217-223`), so `prompt_text` returns two
  newlines + the text + one newline: 1 503 chars against 1 500 (read through `hook::normalise` by a scratch helper
  built against the crate by path).

- **Three sites pin that HEAD shape as expected**, each with the same lab-measured raw prompt (id `2f85`):
  - `hook.rs:490-493`, the `cli_pair` case: raw `"

<pasted_content id="2f85">
A paste
</pasted_content
    id="2f85">
"` → `"

A paste
"`;
  - `hook.rs:652-662`, the property `prompt_text_prop_round_trips_a_wrapped_paste`: `lead` + pair + `"
"` →
    `lead` + text + `"
"`, with `lead` drawn from `""`, `"

"`, `"note: "`;
  - `tests/hook_events.rs:276-282`, the `paste` case of `hook_prompts_arrive_normalised_with_their_origin`: the
    same raw prompt → `"

A paste {CANARY}
"`.
  A fourth holder, the fuzz seed `fuzz/corpus/hook_stdin/paste-pair`, is input only: the target asserts no text
  (`fuzz/fuzz_targets/hook_stdin.rs:12`, one `is_object` assert). The census: `grep -rn -E
  'unwrap_pastes|unescape_tags|prompt_text|pasted_content' crates src tests fuzz scripts schemas
  fixtures/fake-scripts .config`, hits outside `hook.rs` in those two files only.

- **Two spec sentences disagree once the framing is measured.** architecture [CLI Version Compatibility] says the
  unwrap "keeps the ends byte for byte" (`.andromeda/architecture.md:81`). architecture [Delivery Confirmation]
  says matching compares the sent text with `prompt-submitted`'s `text` exactly, after the wrapper is removed
  (`:49`), and the `prompt-submitted` contract says `text` "is the submitted prompt as it was sent" (`:292`). The
  direction resolves it for the second (inputs#I4); line 81 becomes an expected amendment.

- **`send` and the wrapped shape (read from the code; no `send` was run).** `SendSlot::claim` takes a prompt for
  the in-flight send only on `f.text == text` (`src/run/send.rs:81-90`), and `append_hook_event` moves the wheel to
  the human for an unclaimed prompt the hook filed `human` (`:146-167`). The only reader of the normalised text
  outside `hook.rs` is that claim (`grep -rn 'data\["text"\]' src/run src/cmd crates/viola-mcp/src`: `send.rs:147`,
  and `src/cmd/run.rs:95`, a type check).

- **The fake agent can carry the case.** `Wrapper::boot` hands its extra arguments to the fake agent
  (`tests/cli_send.rs:28-42`, the `boot` helper; `--local-command-mode` at `:374`), and `submit`
  (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs:425-445`) is where `--framing` answers a text whose stem is `paste-1` with the
  recorded variant. So a `send` of the compiled long text against a `--framing` agent reaches the wrapper as the
  recorded wrapped prompt. This is test-plan §6 Path 2 step 3's first half (`.andromeda/test-plan.md:738`), which
  no test builds today (M3).

- **The escape, as measured mid-text.** The typed `<pasted_content id="1">` and its close arrived as
  `<\pasted_content …>` and `<\/pasted_content …>`; the typed `<task-notification>` arrived as typed. The doc
  comment on `prompt_origin` (`hook.rs:171-175`) and architecture's Tag escaping bullet (`architecture.md:89`) say a
  typed tag arrives escaped. The start-of-prompt position was not measured.

- **`/clear`.** SessionEnd (`reason` `clear`, the old session, with `prompt_id`) then, 30 ms later, SessionStart
  (`source` `clear`, a new `session_id`, no `model` key); no UserPromptSubmit; the input box settled 1.3 s after.
  The Ctrl-C exit fires one more SessionEnd (`reason` `prompt_input_exit`), so Run B's capture set holds two
  SessionEnd captures and the `/clear` one is told apart by `reason` or claim order.

- **Static readings of the 2.1.287 binary's bundled script** (no session; not live measurements): a paste becomes a
  reference, and so is wrapped, when it is longer than 800 characters or holds more than 2 lines; the wrapping sits
  behind a feature flag whose compiled default is off; when the pasted text already ends in a newline the CLI adds
  none before the close tag, so `paste_pair` would take that text's own last newline for the pair's.

- **Unmeasured, and left so:** a wrapped paste beside typed text in one prompt; two wrapped pastes in one prompt; a
  pasted text that ends in a newline.

title: M11 — the red record round, and what the wait change touches (the second revision, inputs#I6)

data.head: ### M11 — the red record round, and what the wait change touches (the second revision, inputs#I6)

body:
- **The round** (`evidence/record-round-red.md`, `evidence/round-203444Z.txt`, rows 2-6 of
  `evidence/live-sessions.md`): `stamped 2.1.287  15 pass  2 fail`, exit 1, nothing recorded. The CLI's own
  transcript of Run B holds two prompts, the probe prompt and the wrapped long text (id `31a3`); the tag-like text
  and the local command were never pasted. Run B lasted about 12 s.

- **The footer after a long paste** (measured from step 0's raw PTY bytes through `Screen`, and from step 0's drive
  log, both read after the round and recorded in `evidence/record-round-red.md`; the scratch files themselves are
  outside the repository and under the temp dir, which `inputs.py snap` refuses as a source): from the paste on, row
  23 reads `paste again to expand` and no row holds `for agents`; the footer line is drawn again late in that
  window. Step 0 read the input box settled 5.8 s after the long-paste turn's Stop, 1.3 s after the tag-like turn's
  and 1.3 s after the local command, each with 1 s of quiet. Step 0's long turn took 3.4 s; the round's took 1.5 s.
  The hint's length as a timer from the paste is an inference from that one run (about 8 s), not a measurement.

- **What Run B does with it** (read from the tree as the first implement run left it, uncommitted):
  - `framing_turns @ src/cmd/verify/typed.rs:257` pastes each added text only when `input_box_up @ :225` holds over
    the rows the previous settle returned (`:261`, `:278`), and takes those rows from `Run::settle` (`:276`);
  - `settled @ :478` answers a quiet screen that holds a compiled literal at once, and a quiet screen without one
    only at `from + GATE_MAX_WAIT`, with its rows as they are; `Run::settle @ :570` polls it up to `PROBE_DEADLINE`;
  - so a footer that stays replaced for more than 5 s after the Stop yields rows without the literal, and the guard
    pastes nothing more. That is the round's reading.

- **Who else calls the settle** (`grep -n -E '\.settle\(' src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`: 8 call sites): Run A's modal
  (`:76`), Run B's ready (`:105`) and first turn (`:246`), Run C (`:155`), Run D (`:185`), `input_box_settles`

Three smaller items ride with it. The readiness-gate reading is measured end to end under the fake agent, with the

gets the remove-the-guard control it lacks. Two comments that still say verify makes seven settles are brought to ten.
No live `claude` session is planned: zero (inputs#I1). No ledger row, no stamp, no recorded fixture.
Research's `## Files to modify` is the boundary. Tests are written before the change they pin and read red first.

1. **The mirror's fourth line** — `src/human.rs`. Add the writer for the unconfirmable outcome beside
   `write_read_back`, through `mirror_line` like the other three, one `write_all`. Its line is the open box, the
   word `unconfirmable`, the name, then the one fixed note:
   `[  ] unconfirmable  builder  local command, no measured post-condition` (the sample at
   `layout-templates.md:419`). No time, no cursor, no hint. Unit cases: the exact bytes in one write; the writer joins
   `write_send_mirror_words_line_up` (the name column, ASCII, no ESC byte) and
   `send_writers_return_the_writer_error`.

2. **The slot learns two facts** — `src/run/send.rs`, `src/cmd/run.rs`.
   - `SendSlot::new` takes the version gate's `cli_verified`. Both outside callers pass it: `start` @
     `src/cmd/run.rs:216` passes the value read at `:209`; the test helper `methods` @ `src/cmd/run.rs:637` passes a
     literal. The 15 unit-test call sites in `src/run/send.rs` each pass a literal

   - The slot remembers the `agent_session_id` of the last `session-start` line the tap appended, whatever its cause.
     `append_hook_event` @ `src/run/send.rs:140-173` sets it, under the same lock as the claim.

3. **The decision** — `src/run/send.rs`, in `send` @ `:224-276`. Every refusal rung stays where it is and applies to

   - **Not listed:** as today.
   - **Listed, and its post-condition is none, or the version is not verified:** `send-issued`, the paste, then at
     once, with no window: the record `send-confirmed {cursor, confirmed:false}` in `events.ndjson`, the process-log
     line `send-confirmed` with `confirmed = false` and the same `corr`, `rpc_id`, `conn`, `srv_conn`, `from`,
     `from_trust`, `duration_ms` fields the confirmed line carries, and the reply
     `{"ok":{"confirmed":false,"detail":"unconfirmable","cursor":<cursor>}}`. A failed paste is `input-not-ready`
     with the cursor, as for any send.
   - **Listed with `PostCondition::NewSession` on a verified version:** `send-issued`, the paste, then the window.
     The in-flight send waits for its post-condition and for nothing else; a `prompt-submitted` never claims it.

4. **The post-condition claim** — `src/run/send.rs`, in `append_hook_event`. A `session-start` line confirms the
   in-flight send when that send waits for a new session, the line's `cause` is the string `clear`, and its
   `agent_session_id` is a string that differs from the remembered id. Both fields are read as data that may be
   absent or `null`; neither then confirms. The order is the landed one: claim under the lock, append the line,
   settle with that line's `ts`. The send then ends through `Ctx::confirm` unchanged: the record
   `send-confirmed {cursor}` and the reply `{"ok":{"submitted_at":<that ts>,"cursor":<cursor>}}`. If the window
   closes first, the send is `not-delivered` / `no-prompt-submitted` with its cursor. The remembered id moves on
   every appended `session-start`, claimed or not.
   - Basis that the equality decides the recorded case: `SessionStart.default.json` carries `c0f0cc23…` and
     `SessionStart.clear-1.json` carries `d5d38bc2…` with `source` `clear` (research M4), so on a stamped wrapper the
     boot's line sets the remembered id and the replayed `clear-1` line differs from it.

5. **The client** — `src/cmd/send.rs`, in `deliver` @ `:198-202`. An `ok` whose `confirmed` is `false` goes to a new
   `Out` arm: under `--json` the same document as any `ok` (`{"v":1,"ok":…}`), otherwise step 1's line on stdout.
   Exit 0, nothing on stderr. Every other `ok` goes to `read_back` as today.

6. **Unit cases** — `src/run/send.rs`, inline, expectations written as literals. Every case asserts the reply, the
   kinds in `events.ndjson`, the terminal record's `data`, what was pasted, and that the slot is free again.
   - `send_local_command_without_a_measured_post_condition_is_unconfirmable`, three cases: `/remote-control`
     verified, `/remote-control` unverified, `/clear` unverified. Each runs on a clock that never advances, so a
     window wait would hang the case: kinds `send-issued`, `send-confirmed`; the record's data is
     `{"cursor":0,"confirmed":false}`.
   - `send_local_command_clear_is_confirmed_by_a_new_session`, one case: verified, a `session-start` with cause
     `clear` and a new id fed through `append_hook_event`; kinds `send-issued`, `session-start`, `send-confirmed`;
     `submitted_at` is that line's `ts`; the record's data is `{"cursor":0}`.
   - `send_local_command_clear_is_not_confirmed_by_another_session_start`, three cases on a jumping clock: cause
     `clear` with the remembered id, cause `startup` with a new id, cause `clear` with a `null` id. Each line is
     appended unchanged and the send ends `not-delivered` / `no-prompt-submitted` with its cursor.
   - `send_local_command_window_expiry_is_no_prompt_submitted_with_the_cursor`, one case: verified `/clear`, nothing
     fed, the jumping clock.
   - `send_local_command_decision_is_exact_text_never_a_leading_slash`, five cases: `/clear ` with a trailing
     space, `/clear` with a trailing newline, ` /clear` with a leading space, `/CLEAR`, `/andromeda-arch`. Each is
     an ordinary send: with no prompt it ends `no-prompt-submitted` at the window's expiry, never `unconfirmable`.
   - `send_refusal_order` gains three cases with the text `/clear`: the human's wheel, a running turn, a poisoned
     screen. Each is refused as the table says and nothing is typed. It has 12 cases at HEAD (`grep -c "#\[case::"`
     over the table at `src/run/send.rs:566-628`); it ends with 15.

7. **Integration cases** — `tests/cli_send.rs`. Command texts, details and exit codes are literals in the test.
   - `send_window_local_command_is_not_presumed_delivered` is rewritten in place and keeps its name. The wrapper is
     the unverified `--local-command-mode` one it boots today. `/clear` under `--json`: exit 0, the one document
     `{"v":1,"ok":{"confirmed":false,"detail":"unconfirmable","cursor":L}}` with `L` the log's length before the
     send, stderr empty; the records after `L` are `send-issued` then `send-confirmed` with data
     `{"cursor":L,"confirmed":false}`; the receipt holds one prompt, `submit` `local-command`. Then `/remote-control`
     in human mode on the same wrapper: stdout is exactly step 1's line, stderr is empty, exit 0. Then the role log
     `diagnostics/run-builder.ndjson`: for each of the two cursors one `send-issued` and one `send-confirmed` with
     `confirmed` `false`, no `send-refused`, and no line holding either command's text.
   - `send_clear_on_a_verified_cli_is_confirmed_by_its_new_session`, new, on `stamped_home` with `--fixtures` and
     `--framing`. `/clear` in human mode: exit 0, stdout is one `[RB] read back` line for `builder` ending
     `cursor L`, stderr empty; the records after `L` are `send-issued`, `session-end`, `session-start`,
     `send-confirmed`; the `session-start` data is cause `clear` with the recorded id, written out as a literal; the
     `send-confirmed` data is `{"cursor":L}`; the receipt shows the text typed once.
   - `send_window_slash_text_off_the_list_is_not_delivered`, new, on the unverified `--local-command-mode` wrapper:
     `/not-a-local-command` ends exit 13 `not-delivered` / `no-prompt-submitted` after the window, as the rewritten
     case did before. It carries the `send_window_` prefix because it waits the product's window out.
   - `send_rewritten_path_argument_draws_the_warning`, new, with no wrapper (a bare `TestHome`, as
     `send_leading_slash_argument_exits_before_its_stdin_is_written` runs): the argument
     `C:/Program Files/Git/clear` in the name position, and again after `builder` in the text position. Each
     exits 2 with an empty stdout, and stderr's first line is exactly
     `warning: argument looks like a Git Bash rewritten path`. `v1-29`'s last clause has a unit case for the
     predicate and no case that reads the line (research M12); this is that case. It pins behaviour that
     exists, so its control is a one-shot at implement: the `warn_if_rewritten` call in `parse_name` and in
     `refuse_text_argument` (`src/cmd/send.rs:41`, `:46`) neutralised, the case read red, the calls restored,
     the case read green, both readings in `evidence/rewritten-path-warning-control.md`.
   - `send_under_the_paste_hint_on_a_verified_cli`, new, two rstest cases on `stamped_home` with `--fixtures`,
     `--framing`, `--turn-stop`: `hint` adds `--paste-hint-ms 6000`, `no_hint` adds nothing. Each sends the recorded
     long text (taken from the `paste-1` variant as `send_long_text_wrapped_by_the_cli_is_confirmed` takes it), waits
     for the `turn-ended` record, then sends a second text under `--json`.
     - `hint`: the second send is exit 13, `{"v":1,"refusal":"not-delivered","detail":"input-not-ready"}`; one
       `send-refused` record with no cursor follows the turn, no second `send-issued`; the receipt holds one prompt.
     - `no_hint`: the second send is exit 0 and the receipt holds two prompts.
     The two cases are the measurement and its control in one function: the same sequence, the hold the only
     difference. Neither waits a product window, so the name carries no `send_window_` prefix. The mechanism it
     measures is research M7 and M8.

8. **The fake agent's screen after the tag-like turn** — `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs`, `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs`.
   One new argv option, `--tag-turn-screen <phase>`: with `--framing` and `--turn-stop`, after the turn of the
   compiled tag-like paste, and after no other turn, the agent draws `Screen.<phase>.json` of its set in place of
   the `turn` screen. A missing file draws nothing, like any phase. Parsed in `Opts::parse` and unit-tested beside
   the other options. `fake_agent_tag_turn_screen_draws_the_named_screen_after_the_tag_turn_alone` in
   `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs` pins both halves from the receipt and the terminal bytes the test's own PTY reads.
   No env seam, no committed fixture, no new committed screen phase.

9. **The guard's control** — `tests/cli_verify.rs`, `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`.
   - `verify_pastes_no_local_command_once_the_tag_turn_screen_shows_a_modal`, new: the test's own 2.1.0 set, plus one
     screen it writes itself holding the trust row beside the input-box row, named by `--tag-turn-screen`. Verify
     exits 1; `long-paste-wrapper` and `tag-escaping` read `pass` and `local-command-clear` reads `fail`; in Run B's
     span of the receipt exactly three prompts were typed, and none is `/clear`. The name carries no
     `verify_window_` prefix: after the tag-like turn `box_wait` ends on any compiled literal, so nothing is waited
     out (research M9).
   - The remove-the-guard run, a one-shot at implement: re-read the third check in `framing_turns` (the one before
     the `PROBE_LOCAL_COMMAND` paste, `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs:278-280`), neutralise it, run the new case and read it
     red, restore it, read it green, and record both readings with the line as read before each run in
     `evidence/local-command-guard-control.md`. The file ends with no net change.

10. **The two comments** — `.config/nextest.toml:19`, `tests/support/verify.rs:390`. Each says verify makes "seven
    300 ms settles". Reword both to what the key file states: ten since chunk
    2026-10-06-local-command-and-paste-framing-rows, the kill sized when they were seven (about 2.1 s median on the
    ubuntu coverage leg), the longest verify-driven test at 9.98 s under it in ci#37534758441. No bound, filter or
    count in either file moves.

11. **Evidence** — `evidence/paste-hint-send.md`: the two cases' readings (exit, document, records, receipt), the
    hold, and each case's measured length on this host beside the 20 s kill it runs under in CI.
    `evidence/local-command-guard-control.md`: step 9's two readings.
    `evidence/rewritten-path-warning-control.md`: step 7's two readings for the warning.
- `viola-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-local-command-send-outcomes/evidence/` — the two controls' readings and the forced-window case's readings
- `src/run/send.rs` — the slot's verified bit and remembered session id, the decision, the post-condition claim, the unconfirmable outcome, the unit cases (steps 2-4, 6)
- `src/cmd/run.rs` — `cli_verified` passed to `SendSlot::new` at `start` and at the test helper `methods` (step 2)
- `src/cmd/send.rs` — the client's arm for an unconfirmable reply (step 5); the warning's calls neutralised and restored for its control, no net change there (step 7)
- `src/human.rs` — the fourth mirror writer and its cases (step 1)
- `tests/cli_send.rs` — the rewritten case and the four new ones (step 7)
- `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs` — `--tag-turn-screen` (step 8)
- `tests/cli_fake_agent.rs` — that option's case (step 8)
- `tests/cli_verify.rs` — the control's case (step 9)
- `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` — neutralised and restored for the control's red reading; no net change (step 9)
- `.config/nextest.toml` — the comment (step 10)
- `tests/support/verify.rs` — the comment (step 10)

No live leg: the chunk drives no real `claude` (inputs#I1), so the block holds no `live` or `round` entry and no
liveness probe. The harness smoke boots the fake agent on the seventeen-row stamp, unchanged.

Two controls mutate source and revert, so they are one-shot runs at implement and not entries: step 9's
remove-the-guard run (`evidence/local-command-guard-control.md`) and step 7's run with the warning's calls
neutralised (`evidence/rewritten-path-warning-control.md`). On every re-run the named entries for their cases and
the guard on `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` hold the same properties. The three files under `evidence/` are records
implement writes (step 11), not artifacts an entry produces, so no entry carries `artifact`.

Five builders share this host (inputs#I1). A red whose shape is a stalled start, where every test that spawns a
process stalls by one common amount while tests that spawn nothing pass in milliseconds and no assertion fails on a
value, is re-read once no other build runs before it is treated as real; the red entry's log is read before the
re-run overwrites it (`.claude/rules/verification-harness.md`, 2026-09-29 as extended 2026-10-06).

body:
- (matrix) `verification-matrix.json#v1-29` is claimed here: its two owed clauses land, `unconfirmable` only for a
  ledger-listed local command without a measured post-condition, and `/clear` confirmed by its new-session
  post-condition. The witnesses are the five `send_local_command_` unit functions and the three named outcome
  cases of `tests/cli_send.rs`. The earlier clauses keep their landed witnesses, and
  `send_rewritten_path_argument_draws_the_warning` gives the last clause, a rewritten path draws a warning, the
  witness it lacked.

- (arch) A `send` of a listed local command with no post-condition returns the channel `ok` payload
  `{confirmed:false, detail:"unconfirmable", cursor}`, mirrored as `{"v":1,"ok":{…}}` under `--json`, exit 0, and
  never a `refusal` (per architecture §Standard Contracts → Channel methods / CLI `--json` output; §Conventions →
  Error handling schema / CLI exit codes). Witness: `send_window_local_command_is_not_presumed_delivered`.

- (arch) `/clear` returns `ok` confirmed only when a `session-start` with cause `clear` and a new `agent_session_id`
  lands in the window on a CLI version whose stamp passes; on a version without a passing stamp it returns
  `unconfirmable` (per architecture §Established Decisions → [Delivery Confirmation] / [CLI Version Compatibility]).
  Witnesses: `send_clear_on_a_verified_cli_is_confirmed_by_its_new_session`,
  `send_local_command_clear_is_not_confirmed_by_another_session_start`, the `/clear` unverified case.

- (arch) A slash-led text that is not on the compiled list and is not confirmed still ends `not-delivered`, exit 13;
  `unconfirmable` is produced for nothing else, and the earlier refusal rungs still apply to a listed command (per
  architecture §Established Decisions → [Delivery Confirmation]; §Conventions → Error handling schema). Witnesses:
  `send_window_slash_text_off_the_list_is_not_delivered`, the five exact-text cases, the three new
  `send_refusal_order` cases.

- (arch) The wrapper reads the post-condition through normalised events and the compiled list, the `send` path stays
  std-thread, and the chunk adds no env var, `config.json` key, ledger row or crate dependency (per architecture
  §Infrastructure Patterns → Crate dependency direction; §Cross-cutting Patterns → Capability ledger as the single
  gate / Config management). Witnesses: the entry `git diff --quiet 11c77f7c9349 -- crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs src/run/gate.rs crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`,
  the no-new-env entry; no manifest or lockfile is on the modify list, and CI's supply-chain job is read by the
  `ci.py conclusion` entry.

- (security) A text holding a refused control character is refused `not-delivered` / `control-character` first, on
  the local-command path as on every other, and never returns `unconfirmable` (per security-plan §Input Validation,
  Paste text row). Witness: the existing control rows of `send_refusal_order` and
  `tests/cli_controls_not_disableable.rs`, green in the six-binary entry.

- (security) The decision names only the compiled `LOCAL_COMMANDS` and the version gate's `cli_verified`; no second
  read of `ledger/stamps.json` (per security-plan §Security Anti-Patterns → Code Patterns; §Input Validation, Own
  state files row). Witnesses: the entries `grep -c 'LOCAL_COMMANDS' src/run/send.rs` and
  `grep -rnE 'read_stamps|stamps\.json' src/run/send.rs src/cmd/send.rs`.

- (security) The new outcomes carry closed codes and fixed strings only; the sent command's text is in no role log
  line (per security-plan §Error Handling, External responses; §Bootstrap phases, `logging-redaction-wire`).
  Witness: the role-log assertions of `send_window_local_command_is_not_presumed_delivered`; CI's secret scan, read by
  the `ci.py conclusion` entry.

- (security) At the chunk's last commit the `framing_turns` guard is restored, `viola` reads no new env var and
  gains no flag, and the new fake-agent option lives only in the test-only binary (per security-plan §Security
  Anti-Patterns → Universal; §Dependency Security, CI integration). Witnesses: the `git diff --quiet` entry, the
  no-new-env entry; CI's release check, read by the `ci.py conclusion` entry.

- (obs) An `unconfirmable` send leaves in `run-<name>.ndjson` one `send-issued` and one `send-confirmed` with
  `confirmed:false`, both with `corr` equal to the returned `cursor`, and no `send-refused` for that `corr`; every
  send the changed tests issue ends in exactly one terminal wrapper line (per obs-plan §4 Scenario: Confirmed `send`
  (CL-1) from driver to readback). G4 and G2 pass over the new tests' homes in CI, read by the
  `ci.py conclusion` entry (per obs-plan §9 Gate commands).

- (layouts) The unconfirmable outcome prints on stdout as the open box and the word `unconfirmable`, with the name in
  the column the other mirror lines use, exits 0, and puts no `unable` or `hint:` line on stderr; under `--json` it
  is exactly one document (per layout-templates §Surface: cli, Signature placement; §Component — Hero / signature
  output line, Layout and Machine view).

- (design) A `/clear` send confirmed by its post-condition prints the `[RB] read back` line; every word the changed
  paths print is already in the readback vocabulary; no line carries an SGR byte (per design-system §Surface: cli →
  Component Patterns 2; §Surface: cli → Tokens, Colour decision order).

- (a11y) Piped, the `send` output for both new outcomes holds no SGR, cursor-movement or redraw sequence; the tui

  `test-runner-install`). Witness: the entry `grep -rn 'seven 300 ms' .config/nextest.toml tests/support/verify.rs`.

- (tests) Every entry of the block is green or recorded as the block says; coverage holds lines 85, functions 95,
  regions 80 inside `bash scripts/agent-run.sh pre-push` (per test-plan §10 Coverage thresholds).

- (tests) CI is green on the three OSes for the final HEAD of the operator pass; the acceptance names the run id the
  entry `python -X utf8 /home/turbolet/.claude/skills/andromeda-phase/../andromeda-tools/scripts/ci.py conclusion --sha HEAD --wait 1800`
  read.

  Compatibility]; §Standard Contracts → Channel methods, Event `data` per kind; §Conventions → Error handling
  schema. security-plan §Input Validation; §Error Handling; §Security Anti-Patterns. layout-templates §Output
  structure — `viola send`; §Component — Hero / signature output line. design-system §Surface: cli → Component
  Patterns 2. obs-plan §4 Scenario "Confirmed `send` (CL-1)"; §6; §8. test-plan §6 Path 2; §7 Fake agent; §3

- Research: `research.md` M1-M11; files inspected as listed there.

- **Whose word.** The P4 readiness-gate card: option B — delegate the overseer (founder-delegated, unattended),
  2026-10-06 (inputs#I2). The take-up directive: the operator, 2026-10-06 (inputs#I1).

- **Leans, each decisive on an artifact** (the masters are silent on these points; research M3):
  - leaned `send-confirmed {cursor, confirmed:false}` as the `events.ndjson` record of an unconfirmable send, per
    `verification-matrix.json#v1-10` (every outcome, unconfirmable included, recoverable from the log alone),
    obs-plan §4 (the process log's `send-confirmed{confirmed:false}`) and design-system's CL-1 data dependency. No
    reader of the record exists at the base (research M5), so the added field meets none.
  - leaned `no-prompt-submitted` as the detail when a listed command's measured post-condition does not arrive, per
    architecture [Delivery Confirmation] ("Any other unconfirmed send is `not-delivered`") and the precedent of
    2026-10-04-running-turn-refusal (a second cause under one closed detail). No new detail, no `viola-core` change.
  - leaned the confirming `session-start` line's `ts` as `submitted_at`, per architecture's claim, append, settle.
  - leaned one note for both unconfirmable causes, per layout-templates §IA notes (a second note is a
    human-contract change).
  - leaned exact text equality with the compiled entry, per [Delivery Confirmation] ("exactly (no trim)") and the
    compiled-literal rule of security-plan §Security Anti-Patterns → Code Patterns.

- `.andromeda/playbook.md`'s two `verdict: escalate` patterns (Boundary widening; what ratifies it) were read: no
  step ships a widening. The same text is typed as before, the tap reads two more fields of an event it already
  accepts, and the one new option is in the test-only binary.

- The readiness gate is not changed: `GATE_MAX_WAIT`, `QUIET_PERIOD`, `Screen::verdict` and `Gate::wait_ready` keep
  their bytes — the card's answer (inputs#I2); the guard entry holds it.

- Waiting on a quiet literal-less screen, a longer bound, and typing while the paste hint stands — rejected here:
  each changes what `send` does and is the founder's to decide (inputs#I2).
- No live `claude` session, no `viola verify --record`, no fixture written under `fixtures/claude/` (inputs#I1).

- No new `NotDelivered` detail, no new event kind, no new `ObsEvent`, no field on a send line outside obs-plan §6's
  catalog (which command, which post-condition, `cli_verified`).

- No list or post-condition built from the sent text, a hook payload, `config.json`, an env var or a flag; no
  leading-slash test anywhere in the decision.
- No env seam for the forced window or the screen variant: argv options of the fake agent only.

- No integration case waits the window out on a stamped home: the missed post-condition is a clock-driven unit case,
  because a stamp plus the 10 s window sits too close to `binary(cli_send)`'s 20 s CI kill (research M8).
- No bound in `.config/nextest.toml` moves; a timing red is fixed by cause.
- `/remote-control` is typed only into the fake agent.

- **Sizing:** one builder window. One code strand in two product files plus the client and the mirror, seven new or
  changed test functions at unit level and seven at integration level, one fake-agent option, two one-shot controls,
  two comments. No live session, no recording, no row count moved.

- A second `/clear` on one fake-agent wrapper replays the same recorded id, so it is not a new session and is not
  confirmed. The confirmed case sends `/clear` once; the unit case with the remembered id pins the same fact.

- A local command starts no turn (`append_hook_event` marks a turn on `prompt-submitted` only), so two local
  commands in a row on one wrapper need no scripted Stop between them.

- Under `--framing` without `--local-command-mode` the fake agent fires a UserPromptSubmit for `/remote-control`,
  which the hook would file `human` after the send has returned. Send it only under `--local-command-mode`.

- The agent sleeps the hold on its stdin thread: `Wrapper::stop` returns after it. If the `hint` case nears the
  20 s kill on a CI leg, shorten the hold; never move the bound. Record the measured lengths (step 11).

- The human may type `/clear` while a driver's `/clear` is in flight; the driver's send is then confirmed by the
  human's new session. The same holds today for a prompt matched on its text.

- Step 9's control: re-read the guard's site before each neutralising edit and confirm the edit landed before

**Chunk:** Local-command send outcomes — send's unconfirmable outcome with its mirror line, /clear confirmed by its new-session post-condition
**Date:** 2026-10-06
**Commits:** (base `11c77f7`, the parent of the oldest pre-CI commit; `git log --format='%h %s' 11c77f7..HEAD`)
- `8e66926` chore(2026-10-06-local-command-send-outcomes): operator pre-CI commit, for the run this chunk's verdict reads
- `690aefa` test(2026-10-06-local-command-send-outcomes): operator fix on the operator's word, /remote-control read under --json end to end

- **Symbols / APIs:**
  - **`send` consumes the compiled local-command list.** In `src/run/send.rs` the text of a send is classified by
    exact equality with an entry of `viola_agent_claude::ledger::LOCAL_COMMANDS` (the text as sent: no trim, no case
    folding, never a leading-slash test). Three classes:
    - not listed: an ordinary send, as before;
    - listed and its post-condition is none, or the CLI version is not verified (`/remote-control` on every
      version, `/clear` on a version with no passing stamp): `send-issued`, the paste, then at once, with no
      confirmation window, the outcome `unconfirmable`;
    - listed with `PostCondition::NewSession` on a verified version (`/clear`): `send-issued`, the paste, then the
      10 s window. The send waits for its post-condition only; a `prompt-submitted` never claims it.
  - **The `unconfirmable` outcome.** The channel reply is `{"ok":{"confirmed":false,"detail":"unconfirmable","cursor":<cursor>}}`,
    an `ok`, never a refusal. `viola send --json` prints `{"v":1,"ok":{"confirmed":false,"detail":"unconfirmable","cursor":<n>}}`,
    exit 0, nothing on stderr. In human mode it prints one line on stdout, exit 0, nothing on stderr:
    `[  ] unconfirmable  builder  local command, no measured post-condition` (the open box, the word, the name in
    the mirror's shared column, one fixed note for both causes; no time, no cursor, no hint).
  - **The post-condition claim.** The hook-event tap (`append_hook_event`) confirms the in-flight send when that
    send waits for a new session and the appended `session-start` line's `cause` is `clear` and its
    `agent_session_id` is a string that differs from the id the slot remembers. Order as for a prompt: claim under
    the lock, append the line unchanged, settle with that line's `ts`. The send then ends like any confirmed send:
    record `send-confirmed {cursor}`, reply `{"ok":{"submitted_at":<that ts>,"cursor":<cursor>}}`, human line
    `[RB] read back`. If the window closes first the send is `not-delivered` / `no-prompt-submitted` with its
    cursor (no new detail).
  - **The remembered session id.** The send slot now keeps the `agent_session_id` of the last `session-start` the
    tap took, whatever its cause, under the same lock as the in-flight send. A line with no string id clears it.
    With nothing remembered, any string id counts as new. The id is read from the event's `data` as a field that
    may be absent or `null`. Nothing persists it and no snapshot carries it.
  - **`SendSlot::new(clock, cli_verified, wheel)`** — one new parameter, the version gate's `cli_verified`. Its two
    callers outside `src/run/send.rs` are both in `src/cmd/run.rs`: `start` passes the value it already read from
    the version gate, the test helper `methods` passes `false`. No stamps read was added: the send path reads no
    `ledger/stamps.json` (gate `grep -rnE 'read_stamps|stamps\.json' src/run/send.rs src/cmd/send.rs`: no output).
  - **`human::write_send_unconfirmable(out, name)`** — the fourth mirror writer, beside `write_send_open`,
    `write_read_back`, `write_send_unable`; one `write_all`, through `mirror_line`. Sole caller: the `send` client's
    new `Out::unconfirmable` arm (`src/cmd/send.rs`), which takes every `ok` whose `confirmed` is `false`.
  - **Refusal order unchanged.** Every refusal rung (params, `validate_paste_text`, the wheel, the one in flight or
    a running turn, the readiness gate) applies to a listed command exactly as to any text; a failed paste is
    `input-not-ready` with the cursor.
  - **Fake agent: `--tag-turn-screen <phase>`** — a new argv option of the test-only `viola-fake-agent`. With
    `--framing` and `--turn-stop`, after the turn of the compiled tag-like paste and after no other turn, the agent
    draws `Screen.<phase>.json` of its set in place of `Screen.turn`. A missing file draws nothing. No env seam.
  - No new channel method, event kind, `ObsEvent`, `NotDelivered` detail, env var, `config.json` key, CLI flag of
    `viola`, port, socket or file.

- **Crates / modules:** none added or removed. Changed: the root bin (`src/run/send.rs`, `src/cmd/send.rs`,
  `src/cmd/run.rs`, `src/human.rs`) and its test-only `[[bin]]`. `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`,
  `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs` and `src/run/gate.rs` are untouched (gate
  `git diff --quiet 11c77f7c9349 -- crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs src/run/gate.rs crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`, green).
- **Dependencies:** none. No manifest or lockfile changed.

- **Schema / config:**
  - `events.ndjson`: the `send-confirmed` record's `data` gains an optional field. A confirmed send still writes
    `{cursor}`; an unconfirmable send writes `{cursor, confirmed:false}`. No reader of that record exists in
    product code.
  - process log (`run-<name>.ndjson`): an unconfirmable send writes one `send-issued` and one `send-confirmed` with
    `confirmed:false`, both with `corr` equal to the cursor and the same `rpc_id`, `conn`/`srv_conn`, `from`,
    `from_trust`, `duration_ms` fields the confirmed line carries; no `send-refused`. `schemas/diag-line.v1.json`
    already admitted a boolean `confirmed` on the send lines: no schema change.
  - no `config.json` key, no ledger row, no stamp shape, no fixture recorded.
- **Spec-master edits:** none.

  - the fake agent's argv options: seven → eight (`--tag-turn-screen`). Stated at `architecture.md:355`
    ("seven argv options") and at `test-plan.md:1077` ("seven argv options (no env) for verify's four interactive
    runs", then the list) (`grep -n 'seven argv\|argv option' .andromeda/*.md`: architecture 1 line, test-plan

title: M1 — `send` does not consume the compiled list

data.head: ### M1 — `send` does not consume the compiled list

body:
- `LOCAL_COMMANDS` is `[("/clear", Some(PostCondition::NewSession)), ("/remote-control", None)]`
  (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs:151-154`); `PostCondition` has the one variant (`:143-147`).

- `grep -rn "LOCAL_COMMANDS\|PROBE_LOCAL_COMMAND" --include=*.rs crates src tests`: hits in `ledger.rs`,
  `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs`, `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` and tests only; 0 in `src/run/` and `src/cmd/send.rs`.

- Both names are `pub` in `viola_agent_claude::ledger`, which the root bin already imports from
  (`src/cmd/verify/typed.rs:25`). No re-export is needed.

title: M2 — where `cli_verified` is, and what threading it costs

data.head: ### M2 — where `cli_verified` is, and what threading it costs

body:
- `run` reads it once from the version gate (`src/cmd/run.rs:208-209`) and builds the send slot seven lines later
  (`:216`), before the endpoint serves. The same value already goes to `DialogSlot::new` (`:221-223`) and to
  `gate::start` as the signature set (`:492-493`).

- `SendSlot::new(clock, wheel)` (`src/run/send.rs:58`) has two callers outside its own file, both in
  `src/cmd/run.rs`: `start` (`:216`) and the test helper `methods` (`:637`). Inside `src/run/send.rs` the unit tests
  call it at 15 sites (`grep -c "SendSlot::new(" src/run/send.rs`). A new parameter touches those two files only
  (graph, below).
- The value comes from `read_stamps_strict`; the slot adds no stamps read of its own.

title: M3 — what the specs fix, and where they are silent

data.head: ### M3 — what the specs fix, and where they are silent

body:
- architecture [Delivery Confirmation] (`architecture.md:49`, read whole): a listed command whose measured
  post-condition is met returns `ok`, confirmed; one whose post-condition is "none" or not yet measured on this CLI
  version returns `ok` with `{"confirmed":false,"detail":"unconfirmable"}`; "Nothing else is ever unconfirmable. Any
  other unconfirmed send is `not-delivered`. The decision depends on the ledger, never on a leading slash."

- The wire has two `ok` shapes for `send` (`architecture.md:275`): `{submitted_at, cursor}` and
  `{confirmed:false, detail:"unconfirmable", cursor}`. A post-condition-confirmed `/clear` therefore returns the
  first; design-system gives it the `[RB] read back` line (design extract, Constraints 3).

- Precedent for point 2: chunk 2026-10-04-running-turn-refusal gave `turn-running` a second cause under the one
  closed detail, with no new field, event or schema change (obs history, its item).

title: M4 — the hook tap, and the missing session id

data.head: ### M4 — the hook tap, and the missing session id

body:
- `append_hook_event` (`src/run/send.rs:140-173`) is the one place every hook line passes before it is appended. It
  already ends the running turn on `session-start` (`:158-160`). Its one caller in product code is
  `Methods::dispatch` (`src/cmd/run.rs:117`).

- A `session-start` line's `data` is `{"cause", "agent_session_id"}` (`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/hook.rs:147-155`;
  `cause` is closed, `unknown` otherwise). The wrapper's re-validation of a `hook.event` checks the kind and that
  `data` is an object; it names no `session-start` field (`src/cmd/run.rs:89-99`). So the tap must read both fields
  as data that may be absent or `null`.

- The wrapper keeps no session id: `grep -rn agent_session_id --include=*.rs src crates/viola-state
  crates/viola-core` returns two hits, both test literals (`crates/viola-state/src/events.rs:338`,
  `src/cmd/run.rs:871`). "A new `session_id`" needs the slot to remember the id of the last `session-start` it
  appended.

- The recorded set has what the confirmation needs: `SessionStart.default.json` carries one `session_id`
  (`c0f0cc23…`), `SessionStart.clear-1.json` another (`d5d38bc2…`) with `source` `clear`, and
  `SessionEnd.clear-1.json` a third with `reason` `clear` (`jq '{session_id,source,reason}'` over the three files of
  `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/`).

- A SessionEnd the hook appends directly, without the channel, never reaches the tap (arch history,
  2026-09-27-hooks-to-normalised-events). The confirmation keys on the `session-start` alone.

title: M5 — the outcome writers and the two logs

data.head: ### M5 — the outcome writers and the two logs

body:
